title: Image folder index with deterministic media fixtures
objective: Measure whether the image-set-index craftbook scopes a schema, indexes every image, and evaluates coverage/consistency without relying on live image generation.
prompt: In the `Image Set Index Eval` project, read `images/descriptions.csv` and write `index.json`: a JSON object with an `images` array containing exactly one record for each seeded image. Include filename, caption, tags, dominantColors, orientation, containsText, and qualityFlags. Use only the sidecar facts.

setup.about: Self-contained eval project for non-vision local models. The image descriptions sidecar stands in for deterministic vision output.
setup.missionObjectives: Index every seeded image from images/descriptions.csv into index.json with controlled fields and no invented images.

success.summary: index.json parses, has exactly one row per seeded image, includes captions/tags/colors, and flags are consistent with fixture metadata.

axes.name: structure
axes.description: Layout and hierarchy fit the content; sections are scannable and coherent.

axes.name: grounding
axes.description: Seeded source content is used faithfully — no invented facts or dropped requirements.

axes.name: interactivity
